x-policyengine-digests.canonicalization: RFC 8785 (JSON Canonicalization Scheme) over the stated value after removing object members whose value is null (array elements are kept). Numbers are IEEE 754 doubles; integers must lie within +/-(2**53 - 1).
x-policyengine-digests.execution_identity_sha256: {schema_version, country_id, wrapper, model, core, data, certification_status, certificate?} where certificate keeps only bundle_version, country_id, certificate_sha256, compatibility_basis, certified_for_model_version, certified_for_core_version, certified_dataset_sha256 and certified_by
x-policyengine-digests.outputs_sha256: the canonical output payload the receipt binds
x-policyengine-digests.receipt_sha256: the whole receipt without runtime and without reform.name and baseline.name
x-policyengine-digests.reform.reform_sha256: {representation, payload} where payload is the reform exactly as given in that representation

x-policyengine-rules: years is sorted ascending with no duplicates.
fiscal_year.period_start is 04-06 for uk_fiscal_year and 01-01 for calendar_year; UK receipts use uk_fiscal_year.
wrapper.name is policyengine, model.name is policyengine-uk and core.name is policyengine-core.
certification_status certified requires certificate; uncertified forbids it.
reform/baseline kind current_law has no representation or reform_sha256 and binding content; kind reform has both.
wheel_sha256 and wheel_sha256_evidence are present together or not at all.

A consumer that trusts a certificate checks certificate.certificate_sha256 against the data_releases.<country_id> record of the published policyengine manifest for certificate.bundle_version, or requires certificate_source packaged.
